caption: The drawing features a teapot with a curved, ornate handle on the left and a long, tapered spout on the right. The teapot body is rectangular with rounded edges, and it is elaborately decorated with floral and leafy patterns running horizontally near the top and bottom edges. In the center of the main body, there is an ornate shield with the letter "G" inside, surrounded by scrollwork and floral designs. The lid is domed with a decorative knob at the top. The handle is shaded darker, suggesting a different material or finish, and the spout is slender and slightly curved. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there are two smaller diagrams illustrating decorative motifs: one shows a crown-like design above a pattern similar to the border on the teapot and the other shows a curved leaf pattern. At the bottom left, there are three stamps or marks: "J. SCHANCK," a small block "m," and another round symbol. At the bottom right, there is a scale in inches. The image is rendered in monochrome with detailed shading to indicate the reflective surface and ornamentation, all on a beige background.
title: Silver Teapot
